concerns.text: Phase 6 (T052-T056) is listed as a separate phase dependent on US1, but T056 explicitly updates the schema defined in T019 (Phase 3). T019 writes 'data/processed/descriptors.csv' with a fixed column list. If T052-T055 run after T019, the output file will lack the new columns (effective_bond_length, etc.) unless T019 is re-executed. The order implies T019 runs first, producing an incomplete artifact, then T056 updates the schema definition without re-running the producer (T013/T014/T015). This violates 'Producer before consumer' for the artifact schema.

Task T019 (Write descriptor results) is placed after T015, T020, T021, T022. However, T052-T056 (Phase 6) refine the logic of T015/T020/T021/T022. If T019 runs before T052-T056, the 'descriptors.csv' will be generated using the 'old' logic. The plan implies T052-T056 are 'Revision' tasks to fix the logic, but the ordering places the 'Write' task (T019) before the 'Fix' tasks. The 'Write' task must be the final step in the US1 block, after all descriptor logic refinements (T052-T055) are complete.

Task T043 (Generate scatter plots) is marked as DEPENDENT ON T040 and T041. However, T040 (Compute feature importance) and T041 (Calculate correlations) depend on the model being trained and VIF-filtered. T039 (Iterative VIF loop) re-trains the model. T040 and T041 must run AFTER T039 completes. The current list order (T037, T038, T039, T040, T041, T042, T043) is correct, but T043 is explicitly marked dependent on T040/T041. The real risk is T043 running before T039 finishes if the 'parallel' flag is misinterpreted. Ensure T043 is strictly sequential after T042.

Phase 6 is labeled 'Revision' but contains implementation tasks (T052-T056) that should logically be part of Phase 3 (US1 Implementation) to ensure the 'Write' task (T019) produces the correct final artifact. Splitting the implementation of a feature (US1) into a separate 'Revision' phase that runs after the 'Write' task creates a semantic ordering violation where the artifact is written before the logic is finalized.
